comment: Local catalog entries merged on top of the online registry by scripts/generate-plugin-catalog.mjs. Keeps DSH Desktop's bundled snapshot self-contained without waiting for upstream listing merges. Entries follow the awesome-dsh-plugin registry schema (name/owner/url/category/description/install/added).

description.en: Secure multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness: connect from your phone or browser to your local Harness over an end-to-end encrypted channel (Noise IK with a WebRTC-ready adaptive transport), with device authorization and Remote-gateway-backed capabilities, no shell or arbitrary file access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多端安全远程访问：手机或浏览器通过端到端加密通道（Noise IK + 自适应传输）连接本地 Harness，设备授权管理，远程端通过 Remote 网关开放受限能力，不提供 Shell 与任意文件访问。
